name: review-assist-mcp
description: Turn an AI agent's coding session into a reviewable Intent Document.
long_description: Review Assist runs a two-agent author/reviewer distillation over your coding session and produces an Intent Document — the problem, the assumptions, the rejected alternatives, and an anchored walkthrough of every change — gatekept by a deterministic validator. It also generates a ready-made PR description (with optional Mermaid diagrams) and asks per repository before it does anything. Works with Claude Code, Codex, and any MCP-capable agent.

tools.name: get_generation_guide
tools.description: Return the Intent Document schema and the two-agent authoring protocol.

tools.name: get_role_definitions
tools.description: Return the author and reviewer role definitions for the calling client, and how to spin them up.

tools.name: compute_diff
tools.description: Open the distillation run: run handle, numbered hunk index and base/head SHAs (read-only git). Returns no diff text.

tools.name: read_diff
tools.description: Read the diff a page at a time, broken on hunk boundaries; follow next_cursor, or ask for specific hunks/paths.

tools.name: list_transcripts
tools.description: Locate and rank the session transcript(s) for the repo.

tools.name: import_session
tools.description: File a session transcript into the repo's store; needed for cloud sessions that leave nothing on this machine.

tools.name: get_spine
tools.description: Read a session's whole conversation in one call, each item indexed into the full transcript.

tools.name: read_transcript
tools.description: Read a window of the full transcript around a spine index, for the tool output behind a claim.

tools.name: record_interview_round
tools.description: Record the reviewer's questions; each comes back with a q_id to relay to the author.

tools.name: answer_questions
tools.description: The author's own answers, by q_id — the half of the interview the server can attest.

tools.name: submit_document
tools.description: Validate a candidate Intent Document; on pass write it and return a PR description.

tools.name: set_consent
tools.description: Record whether Review Assist may operate on a repository (always/once/never).

tools.name: manage_consent
tools.description: List or reset per-repository consent decisions.
